title: JANAP 146: General Description and Purpose of Communication Instructions for Reporting Vital Intelligence Sightings (CIRVIS), January 1, 1970
doc_notes: This document is a declassified 1970 manual (JANAP 146) providing instructions for reporting vital intelligence sightings (CIRVIS) in the U.S. and Canada, containing procedural examples rather than historical incident logs.

incidents.summary: Example CIRVIS report of a formation of six jet bombers observed east of Bermuda.
incidents.quote: AIR FORCE TWO FIVE NINE THREE SIGHTED FORMATION OF SIX JET BOMBERS
